scope: English-first research on monk profiles and AI monk video avatars such as Yang Mun. The public directory contains 73 profiles: 4 evidence-reviewed video personas and 69 pending research candidates. The 75-record research archive also retains 2 excluded illustrated/watercolor channels. This is not a complete census.
methodology: Publish explicitly included and pending monk research profiles. Included records carry reviewed video-avatar evidence; pending records remain candidates with their existing unknowns. Exclude illustrated/watercolor accounts and missing-scope records from the directory. An image or discovery lead alone does not establish AI production or video format.
Do not merge accounts on similar names alone. Unknown handles, creators, launch dates, and product URLs remain null with a reason.

Store platform, source URL, capture date, and metric beside each number. Instagram followers, YouTube subscribers, views, seller counters, creator statements, orders, and net profit are different measures.
Summarize video structure without storing full scripts, captions, or downloaded media. Video URLs point to the original platform.
User-provided screenshots are identified as such; their calendar capture date is unknown unless the screenshot itself shows it.

Screenshot-visible handles seed unverified leads. Public metadata is dated and source-linked when read through connected research providers. Direct automated HTTP probes stopped after the robots notice was reviewed. Subsequent headers are observed through normal public visible browser UI under an exclusive registered lease; private and age-restricted content is not opened. Unknown AI origin, creator, language and revenue are not inferred from appearance or audience size.

Audience ordering uses each platform's latest numeric followers/subscribers, never views or historical peaks. All-platform comparisons use the largest single observed audience; cross-platform audiences are not added and may overlap. Provider-rounded figures are labelled in each snapshot status.

Candidate language labels added in the profile audit reflect the visible bio language, not a full spoken-video audit. Public bio links establish attribution to a destination, not store ownership, orders, medical efficacy or revenue.

Public offer observations retain displayed price kind, currency (null when unverified), reference/variant prices and availability separately from paid orders and revenue. Shared products reuse an observation_id across attributed accounts; account offer rows are not distinct product counts. Free/PWYW labels, reviews, subscribers, recipe counts and incomplete pricing placeholders do not establish sales. Discovery hubs or redirects establish routes, not ownership or authorship.
